english: I have four umbrellas.
All four are broken.
The first one — the handle fell off.
The second one — it opens but does not close.
persian: دومی — باز می‌شود اما بسته نمی‌شود.

english: The third one — it is very small. It covers only my head.
persian: سومی — خیلی کوچک است. فقط سرم را می‌پوشاند.

english: The fourth one is the saddest.
It looks perfect from the outside.
persian: از بیرون کامل به نظر می‌رسد.

english: But when it rains, the water comes through.
persian: اما وقتی باران می‌آید، آب از آن رد می‌شود.

english: I don't know how.
I keep all four in my closet.
persian: هر چهار تا را در کمدم نگه می‌دارم.

english: I never throw them away.
My friend says: just buy a new one.
persian: دوستم می‌گوید: فقط یک تا نو بخر.

english: I say: maybe next week.
When it rains, I use the third one.
persian: وقتی باران می‌آید، از سومی استفاده می‌کنم.

english: My head stays dry.
The rest of me gets very wet.
People look at me on the street.
persian: مردم در خیابان به من نگاه می‌کنند.

english: I look back at them and smile.
persian: من هم به آنها نگاه می‌کنم و لبخند می‌زنم.

english: At least my head is dry.
That is something.
